queries: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), ranked AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS place FROM order_counts) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM `order` AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), scored AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference DESC) AS place FROM scored) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY difference DESC, account_id;

WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), ranked AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM account_orders) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, difference_from_average FROM ranked WHERE order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, account_id;
